title: feat(studio): the flow designer opens full-screen on its metadata address; no flow rail (#36903)
body:
Fixes #36903
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 搭建者在 Studio 点开一个流程，会在右侧全屏打开它的设计器，左上角 × 回到流程列表，右上角 ‹ › 看上一个、下一个；原来设计器左侧那一列流程列表没有了，组织级流程也在同样的新地址上打开。
- 这是 Studio 重构专题（全屏详情）里的流程设计器一张，和对象、权限集的设计器做法一致。
- 出错时最可能是旧书签或旧链接没跳对、或某个流程打不开；改动只在控制台界面，回退这个 PR 即可恢复原样，不改协议。
- 这个 PR 超过 3000 行，按您的裁决在席位审核通过后请您审核；另有一个问题请您定：流程列表要不要加“触发对象”和“运行状态”两列（需要另开一张协议卡）。

## What changes

- **The flow designer is full-screen on its metadata address.** `/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/flow/NAME` mounts the designer (`AutomationsPillar`, now fixed on one flow named by the route) through the area's new `AREA_DESIGNER_PAGE_TYPES` (`metadataArea.ts`), the shape #37089 uses for the permission set. Header: the shared full-screen item header (`ResourceDetailHeader`): × back to the list with its filters, ‹ › in the list's order (decision 10), title, type, package, and the flow's ⋯ (New similar, Delete). Tabs: Canvas, Variables, Runs, Problems, Debug, then References, History, Source from `item-tools/ItemToolTabs` (hand-off §2); the open tab is `?tab=` (`flowDesignerTabs.ts`). The item-tools menu and its sheets are gone from this page.
- **No flow rail.** The rail, its search, object groups, legend, status dots, contributed-flow rows and the pillar's own New dialog are deleted. Create is the list's 「新建」 (`MetadataListCreateDialog`, same presets).
- **Address switch.** `flow` leaves `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR`, so `studioItemPath`, ⌘K, the AI artifact links and the Changes drawer open the new address. Old addresses redirect (`automationsPillarRedirect.ts`): `/automations?surface=flow:NAME` to the flow, bare `/automations` to the list; `?view=`/`?nav=` dropped, everything else kept (including `?changes=review`).
- **`~org` flows** live on the package-less scope's own area leg: list `/studio/~org/metadata/flow?source=runtime`, flow `/studio/~org/metadata/flow/NAME?source=runtime`. `areaLocationRedirect` settles that leg; its list offers no 「新建」 (the area host is read-only to create there; the designer opens writable). The menu's 「组织流程」 entry points at the list.
- **Kept (card item 6):** the copilot's refresh after its edits (`useMetadataRefreshNonce` re-reads the scope's flows without reloading the buffer an author edits) and its current-item report (`onSurfaceLabelChange`, plus the copilot now reads the open flow off the address, `areaDesignerItemOf`). #36726's pinned publish on Save and on the switch is unchanged.
- **Moved create pin.** The list dialog's flow create now publishes with `publishCreated` (`If-None-Match: *`), the pin the pillar's create carried; without it this PR would have dropped it.
- **Run status (card item 2):** the list has no column for it or for the trigger object (spec columns are NAME, LABEL, type, DESCRIPTION). Both stay on the designer header (Trigger and Status pills). No `packages/spec` change; the column question is raised to the seat as a fork.

## Empty state and old deep links (card item 7)

- A package with no flow: the flow list's own empty state; the designer is never opened on nothing.
- An address naming a flow the package does not hold: one block, 「The link names flow “NAME”, which is not here.」, no aside, nothing else opened. If the flow is package-less it opens in `~org` instead (objectui#11553's rule, kept).
- Old `/automations` and `/studio/~org/automations` links: redirected as above. `…/metadata/flow/NAME/history` opens the History tab (the area's designer-item exemption no longer covers flows).

## Tests

- Converted to the address: the 14 remaining `AutomationsPillar.*` suites (create cases rehosted on the list dialog), and the `StudioDesignSurface.*` suites that opened a flow (org scope, status truth, registration, caption, held edits, publish, slot, read-only, copilot chip).
- Deleted as rail-only: `AutomationsPillar.railSearch-11794`, `FlowStatusDot`, `FlowStatusDot.registration-12349`, `StudioDesignSurface.railUnboundReason-11281`, `.automationsRailOrder-12612`, `.draftObjectFlowGroup-29706`, and the rail cases inside `.emptyStates-12514`, `.homeLoop-12513`, `.oneSurface-28572`, `.autosaveSwitch-11232`, `.heldFlowCreate-26845`, `StudioRail.noMatches-26733`.
- New: `automationsPillarRedirect.test.ts`, `flowDesignerTabs.test.ts`, designer-page and org-leg pins in `metadataArea.test.ts`, × and ‹ › leave-guard cases in `.heldFlowLeave-26705`.
- Local readings and CI check-runs are in the report comment on #36903.

## Acceptance notes

- Header now shows the type chip and API name, per the shared full-screen header (0-2); `flowCanvasChip-11665` pins that the title itself stays the label.
- `AreaHistoryRedirect`'s designer-item exemption is not deleted: on main it still covers object and permission until #36904 and #36905 land; it no longer covers flows. Whichever of the three lands last deletes the line.
- Overlaps #37089 (and the #36904 branch) in `metadataArea.ts`, `studioAddress.ts`, `StudioMetadataArea.tsx`, `studioMenuModel.ts`, `StudioAiCopilot.tsx`; same names and shapes, so the later lander merges.
- Left for #36909 (pillar leftovers): `groupFlowsByObject`, `withContributedFlowGroups`, `ContributedRailRow`, `useOpenContributor`, the console's `/studio/~org` bare route and `BuilderLanding`/`setupMetadataRedirect` producing the old `/automations` (both redirect).

## Verification

First read, by risk: `StudioMetadataArea.tsx` (designer mount, org leg), `metadataArea.ts` (`orgScopeAreaRedirect`), `AutomationsPillar.tsx` (scope read keyed so a copilot pulse never reloads the buffer).

Two-minute check: open `/studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow:showcase_urgent_task_alert`; expect the flow full-screen at `/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/flow/showcase_urgent_task_alert?package=com.example.showcase`, with × to the list and ‹ › enabled.
